technical.summary: ACN shows short-term bullish momentum (RSI rising, three white soldiers, force index cross) but lacks long-term trend confirmation (below 200-day MA) and overbought conditions limit upside; moderate swing entry with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 71 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear directional bias; broad market sentiment neutral with slight bearish lean (42% bearish vs 21% bullish); insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (207.5), inverted yield curve signalling recession risk, and imminent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions; earnings in 71 days poses no immediate binary risk but overall environment is hostile to equity positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + force index cross-up + DC10 new high provide short-term momentum confirmation with defined support at 257.65 for risk management.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 207.5, inverted yield curve, CPI event imminent), overbought oscillators (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R), price below both 200-day and 50-day MAs, zero fundamental support, and high earnings risk in 71 days create a hostile risk/reward environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (three white soldiers, force index cross) offers defined support at 257.65, but this is insufficient to justify entry given macro hostility and existing sector concentration.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (207.5), inverted yield curve, and imminent CPI event create systemic equity headwinds that will likely overwhelm short-term technical momentum; overbought oscillators signal mean reversion risk.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to enter against recommendation: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at 257.65 support breach.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical momentum insufficient to override macro, fundamental, and risk consensus.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 6 IT positions with 42 total open positions; adding ACN increases sector concentration risk during crisis VIX environment and adds earnings binary risk in 71 days with zero fundamental conviction.
